reason: I only buy gummies or drinks because I really don't like swallowing pills, and this is two capsules every day. My doctor did say my magnesium could be low, so I'd look for a gummy or a powder drink instead.
objection: It's capsules, two a day, and I don't swallow pills. Also a foil sachet for every single day sounds like a lot of packaging waste, even if the outer box is paper.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or drink version with the same lab report. Or if my doctor told me capsules were the only form that would work.
